qualification.details: Qualification: 12th pass; 10th pass for ST and SC candidates; Resident (native) of the concerned gram panchayat; Bastar and Surguja divisions: priority order (1) 12th pass (2) 10th pass (3) 8th pass Experience: Not required; experience in government rural development schemes on at least the same honorarium earns merit marks Age limit: 18 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: As per Chhattisgarh General Administration Department orders issued from time to time; maximum age not to exceed 45 years in any case | Other conditions: | Candidate must be a native resident of the same gram panchayat Posts are for field work; 100 percent disability not accepted Persons married to someone with a living spouse are not eligible, save exemption by government order and court order | Desirable: | One-year diploma/certificate (PGDCA/DCA/ITI) from a recognised institution or 6 months as Panchayat-cum-Data Entry Operator (15 merit marks) Experience in government rural development schemes on at least the same honorarium (up to 15 merit marks)

how_to_apply: Get the application format from the district office, Janpad office or gram panchayat notice board, or from www.sukma.gov.in.
Fill it in the prescribed format, paste a self-attested latest photo and attach self-attested certificates.
Attach two blank self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 5 postage stamps each.
Write the post name/category clearly on the envelope.
Send by closed registered post/speed post only to the Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Konta, PIN 494114.
Application must reach between 23-11-2026 and 17-12-2026, by 5:30 PM on office days.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 12th pass; 10th pass for ST and SC candidates; Resident (native) of the concerned gram panchayat; Bastar and Surguja divisions: priority order (1) 12th pass (2) 10th pass (3) 8th pass Experience: Not required; experience in government rural development schemes on at least the same honorarium earns merit marks Age limit: 18 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: As per Chhattisgarh General Administration Department orders issued from time to time; maximum age not to exceed 45 years in any case Other conditions: Candidate must be a native resident of the same gram panchayat Posts are for field work; 100 percent disability not accepted Persons married to someone with a living spouse are not eligible, save exemption by government order and court order Desirable: One-year diploma/certificate (PGDCA/DCA/ITI) from a recognised institution or 6 months as Panchayat-cum-Data Entry Operator (15 merit marks) Experience in government rural development schemes on at least the same honorarium (up to 15 merit marks)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Janpad Panchayat Konta Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons removed from service by any government department for indiscipline, misconduct, arbitrariness or irregularity Persons married before the prescribed minimum age of marriage Persons married to someone whose spouse is already living, except as allowed by government order and court order Persons with more than two living children, one of whom was born on or after 28 February 2001

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment for one year, fully temporary, up to 28 February 2027 One month's pay to be deposited on resignation during the term Appointing authority may end service with one month's notice No pension, gratuity or death benefit for the period of service Number of posts is variable

content_sections.heading: How Will Janpad Panchayat Konta Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list for each gram panchayat: 70 marks for marks in minimum qualification, up to 15 for experience, 15 for diploma/certificate or DEO experience Scrutiny list displayed on Janpad Panchayat notice board for claims and objections 70 marks: weightage of marks obtained in the minimum educational qualification Equal marks: older candidate selected first Grade-only marksheets get the average percentage of that grade Gram panchayat-wise merit list with a waiting list of 10 names valid for 1 year

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested native resident certificate of the gram panchayat Permanent caste certificate and permanent resident certificate (reserved posts) Degree/provisional degree/marksheets, self-attested, including the back side Experience certificate with appointment order (to claim experience marks) NOC through proper channel if employed in government/semi-government/non-government institutions Two self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 5 stamps each; medical board certificate for persons with disabilities

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Janpad Panchayat Konta Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Get the application format from the district office, Janpad office or gram panchayat notice board, or from www.sukma.gov.in. Fill it in the prescribed format, paste a self-attested latest photo and attach self-attested certificates. Attach two blank self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 5 postage stamps each. Write the post name/category clearly on the envelope. Send by closed registered post/speed post only to the Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Konta, PIN 494114. Application must reach between 23-11-2026 and 17-12-2026, by 5:30 PM on office days.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Janpad Panchayat Konta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Janpad Panchayat Konta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 40 vacancies for Employment Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Janpad Panchayat Konta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format on pages 7-9 of this notice; also at district office, Janpad office, gram panchayat notice board or www.sukma.gov.in) and send it to Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Konta, District Sukma (Chhattisgarh), PIN 494114, by closed registered post / speed post only, to reach by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: As per Chhattisgarh General Administration Department orders issued from time to time; maximum age not to exceed 45 years in any case.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Lump-sum monthly honorarium of Rs. 9960.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th pass (10th pass for ST and SC) and resident of the concerned gram panchayat; for Bastar and Surguja divisions the priority order is 12th pass, 10th pass, 8th pass.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a native resident of the same gram panchayat. Posts are for field work; 100 percent disability not accepted. Persons married to someone with a living spouse are not eligible, save exemption by government order and court order.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons removed from service by any government department for indiscipline, misconduct, arbitrariness or irregularity. Persons married before the prescribed minimum age of marriage. Persons married to someone whose spouse is already living, except as allowed by government order and court order. Persons with more than two living children, one of whom was born on or after 28 February 2001.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list for each gram panchayat: 70 marks for marks in minimum qualification, up to 15 for experience, 15 for diploma/certificate or DEO experience. Scrutiny list displayed on Janpad Panchayat notice board for claims and objections. 70 marks: weightage of marks obtained in the minimum educational qualification. Equal marks: older candidate selected first.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment for one year, fully temporary, up to 28 February 2027. One month's pay to be deposited on resignation during the term. Appointing authority may end service with one month's notice.
